high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the account "techinsider." The post is titled "Downsides of Tesla's steering yoke" and discusses a criticism regarding Tesla's decision to place the horn as a button on the steering wheel (yoke) instead of in the center console, which is common in other car models. The text within the post explains that Brownlee, presumably a critic or reviewer, pointed out that people have developed muscle memory over years of driving to slam the horn when something dangerous is about to happen.
